overview: The Medford Historical Commission reviewed MassDOT's South Medford Connector Path project and site plans for the proposed Tufts Aquatic Center. The commission also addressed pending demolition review inquiries, the Medford High School Section 106 process, and ongoing archaeological and cemetery restoration projects.

items.title: South Medford Connector Path Section 106 Review
items.summary: The commission agreed to submit a comment letter advising MassDOT to route the proposed bicycle connector along the Mystic River corridor rather than alongside Route 16.

items.title: 161 Mystic Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: The commission reviewed the site plan package for 161 Mystic Avenue and agreed to pass without submitting formal comments.

items.title: 85 Main Street Site Plan Review
items.summary: The commission confirmed it had no comments regarding the proposed retail building at the 85 Main Street gas station site.

items.title: Tufts Aquatic Center Site Plan Review
items.summary: Commissioners reviewed plans for the proposed Tufts Aquatic Center on College Avenue and authorized Doug Carr to represent the commission's concerns to the Community Development Board regarding the building's facade and public street engagement.

items.title: Demolition Review Inquiries: 140 Grant Avenue and 9 Sturgis Street
items.summary: Chair Jennifer Keenan referred potential demolition review requests for 140 Grant Avenue and 9 Sturgis Street to the subcommittee for evaluation.

items.title: Commission Membership and Vacant Seats
items.summary: The commission welcomed new appointee Luke and discussed outreach efforts to recruit additional members.

items.title: Medford High School Section 106 Review
items.summary: Ryan Hayward reported on attempts to obtain building documentation from the high school project consultants to complete a historic inventory form for the 1970 structure.

items.title: Demolition Delay Updates
items.summary: The commission noted no new updates on 41 Mystic and confirmed 16 Manning Street remains under demolition delay.

items.title: Annual Report Draft
items.summary: The commission reviewed the draft annual report and requested minor adjustments concerning legal advertising expenses before submitting it by the end of the week.

items.title: Historic and Archaeological Projects Updates
items.summary: Updates were provided on the rescheduled Brooks Estate archaeological survey, volunteer artifact cleaning from Thomas Brooks Park, tree management work, restoration contracts for Cross Street Cemetery, and survey funding for Hastings Heights.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The meeting minutes from the March 9 meeting were approved.
